title: Fermi America secures firm gas supply from Energy Transfer for Project Matador

sources.quote: Natural Gas Supply and Fuel Infrastructure On October 9, 2025, we announced that we secured firm natural gas supply arrangements with Energy Transfer intended to support Phase 1 operations.

explain: Fermi America, which is building the 'Project Matador' private power-and-data-center campus near Amarillo, Texas, arranged firm natural gas supply from Energy Transfer for its first phase of gas-fired generation. Volumes and price not disclosed.
